study.question: Does the apparent value of the full-task auxiliary orientation bit require correct auxiliary label correspondence at fixed recipient features/probabilities, beyond the native auxiliary radius and support?
study.hypothesis: Correct auxiliary labels may affect a useful global orientation bit. Earlier cotangent donor controls transported both donor labels and donor feature/probability Jacobians, and the paired donor was exactly ineffective in validation while occupied-cycle changes were tiny. Differentiate an occupied-label-cycle BCE at unchanged recipient predictions solely to replace the bit; preserve ordinary true-label private learning and all native real-transfer geometry. A weaker true-label sign advantage under this verified bit intervention would support a conditional label-dependent contribution; equivalence despite substantial disagreement would argue against that requirement.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest actual implementation: retain its entire forward model and native radius/support, but add a counterfactual-label VJP and a collector with seven outputs to supply only an alternate bit. Unlike g3-r0064/g3-r0065 donor controls, labels are replaced before differentiation at recipient computation.

Archived primary lines245-284 inspected and supplied baseline source read. Inherit target-conditioned unnormalized local activation as adapted by ancestors; the present delta is training-only auxiliary-bit attribution, not a new DIN attention mechanism or exact paper reproduction.

Authorized original PDF2508.11565v1 inspected via web, pages1-2/lines135-196: task tokens and shared proxies modulate feature interaction. Its pinned benchmark forward123-170 was also read. The current model does not adopt this forward architecture; the delta tests auxiliary label dependence of a context-backward bit. No external effectiveness or originality claim is transferred.

Cached section2.3 inspected as an architecture map. It does not establish effectiveness of the present loss/gradient control. Dedicated gradient-method priority search in the authorized registry found no primary match; nearest global gradient-method priority remains unverified.

inherited_components: All fields/history/action visibility and task semantics from frozen host adapter
Entire g3-r0065 native bridge learned architecture, initialization order, sparse tables, DIN scorer, folded-support/Dice state, matched summaries, private residual/product adapters and heads
All original row-space FP64 geometry and helper operations, original native radius, support and true-label joint private objective
Occupied-cycle donor-index helper reused on training-label triples rather than precomputed cotangents
study.proposed_difference: Expand the identity collector from four to seven outputs without changing its six inputs. Outputs0..3 keep click/true-auxiliary uses. The loss hook builds ordinary true-label BCE plus a zero-value linear surrogate on outputs4..6. One torch.autograd.grad of alternate-label auxiliary BCE to outputs1..3 returns detached alternate cotangents without accumulating parameter .grad. The collector receives native and alternate triples separately; only the new assignment selects the alternate Q sign. Real true-label C/O and fixed-angle geometry remain native. Native controls execute all new work. No new parameter, buffer, forward pass or randomness; a transient graph cache is cleared after loss construction and on every forward. Only first derivatives supported.
predictions: At matched state, original and new forward probabilities, private gradients, native geometry/support, parameter count and state keys agree; native bridges replay historical same-sign native outcomes within the host deterministic arithmetic contract. Failure blocks causal interpretation.

On post-initialization occupied training batches, some auxiliary labels and resulting Q bits should change. Count changed labels per task, changed occupied triples and active-batch bit disagreement; unchanged bits mean the intervention is ineffective even if gradients changed.

Conditional on meaningful bit disagreement, correct-label native negative should lose less click AUC than the permuted negative, and the native negative-positive gap may attenuate after permutation. This is a prospective directional hypothesis, not an observation.

Same matched-state private gradients and true-label scalar BCE in every arm; ordinary auxiliary private heads never train on permuted labels. New training cost rises because of an extra backward VJP; eval has the inherited forward and must be measured.
falsifiers: Any native bridge mismatch, changed private gradient ownership, nonfinite loss/gradients, label exposure in forward, altered native radius/support, or unexpected state/parameter change invalidates implementation attribution.

If label and active-bit disagreement are substantial but permuted-label performance is equivalent or better across admissible paired replication, reject the claim that correct recipient-label correspondence is required for this bit in the tested setting.
If bits do not disagree, the new label manipulation is nondiscriminating; do not call a null AUC contrast evidence of label irrelevance.
AUC improvement alone without fixed-state ownership/bit checks and repetition leaves the information-transfer mechanism unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Global sign imbalance, arbitrary pivot orientation and signed optimizer bias can explain sign effects without semantically useful auxiliary label transfer
Auxiliary radius, degeneracy support and private-task learning retain true-label information; this does not test auxiliary supervision removal
A deterministic label cycle may preserve task correlations or mostly exchange zeros; no independence claim
Data-order/coordinate dependence and sparse scatter can change parameter-space geometry despite row-space constraints
BF16/private backward arithmetic and prior search adaptivity can produce small validation changes; no uncertainty from one seed
The tiny incumbent advantage over native is not evidence of meaningful progress

validation_plan: Before training, host must run native bridges against their exact g3-r0065 source at a nonzero learned checkpoint: state keys/counts/initialization, train/eval predictions, Dice buffers, true loss scalar, every private dense/sparse gradient and combined context VJP. The new VJP must leave parameter .grad unset until final backward. Tensor preflight is required; syntax is insufficient.

At the same state/batch, use torch.autograd.grad(true joint loss, edges0..3, retain_graph=True) as native cotangents and alternate auxiliary BCE to edges1..3 as counterfactual cotangents. Calling source_bit_diagnostics on detached tensors reports bits, active support, radius and actual context-VJP difference. It is a callable probe, not a registered automatic collector. Record enough occupied active post-initialization batches to estimate disagreement/balance, not only all-zero initial adapters.

Training-label donor audit: occupied-cycle is bijective on occupied rows, identity on empties, joint cart/fav/buy labels and per-task positive counts preserved exactly in occupied population; n<=1 identity and n=2 exchange. Report changed labels/triples separately from source cotangent change and bit disagreement. Report pivot zeros/ties and positive-bit proportions on native active batches.

Counterfactual VJP correctness: with identity label replacement, extra outputs must receive the same per-task context cotangents as ordinary true BCE; with actual donor labels, compare against explicit independent differentiation at unchanged recipient p. True private gradients remain identical across bit-source choices at matched state, including product-query/output layers, task towers and repeated-ID sparse accumulation. No higher-order differentiation claim.

Native true cotangents alone must set radius, fixed-angle canonical direction and zero support for both sources. At fixed state, new and native transfer are identical for equal bits and negatives for disagreeing bits before cast; norms/support match to FP64 tolerance. After one cast and sparse embedding scatter report discrepancies rather than assume parameter-space orthogonality or optimizer invariance.

Mask/visibility checks: empty, singleton/two occupied, noncontiguous/full histories and masked-field perturbations; empty-history correction zero; current action remains unknown; no current training labels in forward. Preserve historical task masks and offline prefix visibility. Tensor zeros/near-zeros, both signs, FP32/BF16 finiteness, no-grad eval, device/checkpoint roundtrip, transient cache cleared.

Run all four full frozen training/validation arms through the authorized host only, retain negative and failed runs, full-population click AUC plus all-task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, parameter counts/GPU/wall/train seconds/examples/memory and measured inference throughput/p50/p95. Add counts/positives/negatives to inherited history bins; any new slice is exploratory unless prospectively fixed.

Interpret source/sign interaction only after preflight and nontrivial active bit disagreement. Retain single-seed preliminary language; paired user-cluster bootstrap and new seeds require an authorized later interface. Freeze source/config/checkpoint/comparison suite before later withheld assessment; do not reuse withheld outcomes in open research.
